text:
Rina Das: quick sync idea  propose a new 'fast-admit' gate for compact/quant variants. tiny deterministic checks before full bench to block obvious breakages.

Theo Park: +1. What checks?

Rina Das: tokenizer checksum, KV-shape probe, tiny golden set (30 prompts) for output stability, and a short-seq tail-latency P95. Target <90s.

Jared Ramos: metrics suggestion: top1_flip_limit=3, mean_logit_l2<=0.14, p95_latency<=350ms. Fail if 2/3 metrics fail.

Priya Nair: ops: run each runtime target once (cuda/xla/cpu-emu) to catch ABI/kernel misses. Use same quant libs as production.

GateBot: noted. will upload artifacts on fail to s3://redwood-fast-admit/<model>/<variant>/<ts>/ with probes.ndjson, summary.txt, env.txt and post link.

Theo Park: to reduce noise, add a probation state machine: 1st failure = advisory + auto-schedule full bench, 2nd consecutive failure (48h) = block ingest. owners can override with platform-experiment label.

Rina Das: agree. also add cluster toggle: strict|advisory|off for infra incidents so infra rollouts don't cause mass blocks.

Jared Ramos: fallback routing: if variant fails after deploy, route traffic to parent stable snapshot automatically and mark variant quarantined.

Priya Nair: I'll add a small dashboard for counts and a short runbook for triage. retention default 30d for artifacts.

Rina Das: action items: 1) add fast-admit job (blocking for compact variants), 2) config schema in model manifest, 3) probation state machine, 4) GateBot artifact upload + 30d retention, 5) auto-fallback routing, 6) cluster-level toggle + runbook, 7) RFC update with examples.

Theo Park: I'll wire K8s job + manifest hook. Jared will own fallback routing. Priya owns toggle + dashboard. GateBot will implement uploads. Rina will draft RFC.

Rina Das: thanks all  I'll open the RFC PR and tag owners. Ping here for followups.
